Load the tuning values of an SMC run with esjd adaptation.

Source: R/load_output.R
load_smc_tuning.Rd

With smc_adapt = esjd(...) on a move, each particle of SMC_with_MCMC moves with its own tuning values, chosen from how far the particles moved at the previous step. This function reads the summary of those values written at each step: per tuned move and parameter, the mean, standard deviation and 10%, 50% and 90% quantiles over the particles.

Usage

load_smc_tuning(results_directory)

Arguments

results_directory

The results directory of the run (results_name).

Value

A data frame with one row per move step and tuner: columns step (the move step: 1 for the first move), tuner (its number, when several moves or proposals are tuned), variable, and for each tuned parameter (scale, or step and steps) its mean, sd, q10, q50 and q90; for pretune also step_max and steps_max (the ranges of the next trial moves); for choose, kernelK.share (the share of the particles using each proposal).
